note: Registered lab artifacts that make up the tester release. File sources are relative to the workspace root (BC250_ROOT), licence sources to the repository. build-release.ps1 refuses a source whose SHA256 differs. The AMD firmware is not packaged: the installer downloads it at the pinned commit.

mft_h264.note: The H.264 encoder Media Foundation transform (M15.11). register true: the installer copies payload/mft/amdgpu_wddm_mft_h264.dll to <install root>\mft\ and writes route A of driver/umd/mft-h264/INSTALL.md machine wide. register false: the installer installs and registers nothing, and takes away what an earlier install of this release family wrote. The value travels into manifest.json, so the package itself says what it does. This is the bisect lever of the encoder wagon.

public_commits.note: Built commit -> commit on a public branch, for every pair that differs. The b19 part of this release is published: D-Ogi/amdgpu-wddm holds 85ac47b6 and 3ef45a0f on branch train/b19-setup, and D-Ogi/mesa-amdgpu-wddm holds 31844893 on amdgpu-wddm/b19-icd, 76ab2c27 on amdgpu-wddm/b19-desktop-umd and 7117b189 on amdgpu-wddm/b19-hosted-umd. D-Ogi/dxvk, D-Ogi/vkd3d-proton and D-Ogi/dxil-spirv keep branch amdgpu-wddm/upstream-2026-10-05. The system Vulkan ICD is the build of 2732f9c8, which the fork publishes on branch amdgpu-wddm/gdi-immediate-quiet (597fc6e2), as in 0.7.205.100-tester.11. The hosted ICD of the desktop route is the build of 48546c73. The b20 part is NOT published yet. Four commits of bc250-win branch train/b20-setup built it: 60c97ad3 (the kernel driver), 689852a8 (both D3D11 shells, both routers and the encoder transform), aec3679e (the D3D12 shell, the control application, the control DLL and the CLI). The two caps records are byte for byte the b19 ones, because b20 reuses the b19 engines and ICDs. Push train/b20-setup to D-Ogi/amdgpu-wddm before this release goes to a tester. Each b20 wagon is an ancestor of the branch head: train/b19-repro-kmd edae6987, kmd209-iflip2 b03da3a7, fan/read-nct6686 9d1aff7c, c48/notifydpc-in-report 677709c2, tuner/vf-cpu dabdd949, m15/router-iflip-front 99ba8cd8, bd075/capshare-trace 3325c555, bd075/d3d12-shared-real 1fa1cfb6 and e52/encoder-perf e4d1f630, on main 42b85d25. Three files come from a build of a b19 wagon, not from a b20 commit: payload/syswow64/bc250umd.dll from train/b19-wow64-x86 a748e78e, and the two desktop CPU and hosted UMDs from their Mesa branches. The x86 patches of the earlier releases are gone (BD-064). Both b19 RADV files report git-3184489333 as their Mesa version, which is 31844893. The two routers of this release come from a tree at 689852a8 whose only uncommitted change was the router gate's own test file, which e79f72e0 then committed: no source of either DLL differs between the two commits.

files.role: KMD 0.7.212.1 INF (bc250-win 60c97ad3, train/b20-setup). It adds the two Parameters values of the fan reader, both 0. The release re-stamps DriverVer and adds the Reboot directive

KMD 0.7.212.1, escape ABI 0x000700D4 (bc250-win 60c97ad3, train/b20-setup: main 42b85d25 with the five b20 kernel wagons). The kernel is built with /Brepro and a sorted object list, and three builds of this lineage gave the same unsigned bytes. Five changes against 0.7.208.1, and each new behaviour is off until a Parameters value turns it on. The driver can hand its own swap-chain buffers to the scan-out hardware (route C, EnableDirectFlipHandshake). It can read the fan speed, the fan duty and its own temperatures from the Super I/O chip (EnableHwmon). It can pair the notification of a finished packet with the report pass itself (NotifyDpcInReport), and it keeps a histogram of the gap between the ring and the vertical blank. The operator can give the automatic clock a voltage curve of their own, and can set a clock limit, an undervolt and a temperature cap for the processor, each one as a trial that falls back by itself. Re-signed with the release certificate, code unchanged
UMD stub, D3D9 slot of UserModeDriverName (driver/umd-stub)

D3D12 shell (bc250-win aec3679e, train/b20-setup). It makes a shared texture inside a known shape instead of refusing it, and it counts every second create attempt (BD-075). A command queue accepts a wait on a fence and lets the system do the waiting, where the shell before this one lost the device. Every earlier behaviour of the b19 shell is kept: heap import retries the ownership unlock (BD-045), ClearRootArguments records the real values (BD-046), the direct recording entry of engine-ddi is the default (M15.9), and the shell records each start of an application for the Recent page. Built with /Brepro, and byte identical over two builds of this head

D3D12 engine (vkd3d-proton fork amdgpu-wddm/upstream-2026-10-05 4e9a98e9: 16 upstream commits merged into the b17 compile limiter 220099f5, submodule dxil-spirv d2d82332 = 14 upstream commits merged into bc773cf2)

D3D12 ICD (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b19-icd 31844893 on upstream-2026-10-05). The shader cache key covers the whole shader state again (BD-068). Handle types and host imports follow the contract (BD-038, BD-039). A buffer object takes the CPU lock for a mapped import (BD-045). Host policy version 2 reads no machine-wide file and writes no shared log. The disk cache stays one file. The file reports git-3184489333 as its Mesa version

desktop and application router (bc250-win 689852a8, train/b20-setup, driver/umd/router). gpu-default keeps Windows components and unresolved images on the CPU UMD, as in b19. The router gains the Direct3D 11.1 front of route C (M15.14), which the value DirectFlipFront under HKLM\SOFTWARE\amdgpu-wddm\DesktopRouter turns on. An absent value and a value of the wrong type both leave the shipped router in place, and no installer default writes it. The one later commit of the branch that touches the router (e79f72e0) changes the gate's test file only, not a source of this DLL

hosted zink D3D11 UMD for DWM on the GPU (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b19-hosted-umd 7117b189). The surface setup resumes after a failed step instead of leaking it (BD-037). The composed-surface table accepts one-byte pixels (A8)
hosted ICD for zink

CPU D3D11 UMD (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b19-desktop-umd 76ab2c27). The surface setup resumes after a failed step instead of leaking it (BD-037). The composed-surface table accepts one-byte pixels (A8). This is the fallback route for the D3D11 applications that the router does not send to the GPU

GPU D3D11 shell (bc250-win 689852a8, train/b20-setup). The 11 host tests of the recipe and the DDI error-policy gate pass against it. Built with /Brepro against DXVK fork 5611118e, which b20 reuses from b19 unchanged

GPU D3D11 caps record for engine C242BA6A and ICD 822134D0 (tools/build/write-umd-config.py). The shell refuses an engine or an ICD whose SHA-256 differs from this record. b20 reuses the b19 engine and ICD, so this record is byte for byte the b19 one. Capabilities carried from fl12caps001: FL 12_1, tiled resources tier 3, rasterizer ordered views, conservative rasterization tier 3

GPU D3D11 engine (DXVK fork amdgpu-wddm/upstream-2026-10-05 5611118e: 14 upstream commits merged into the b17 inline-throttle engine ebeadc49, the throttle wait moved to the new upstream wait site, plus the signal-tracker deduplication fix; submodule dxbc-spirv stays at f241996e)
GPU D3D11 ICD (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b19-icd 31844893, static CRT). This is the same build as payload/d3d12/amdgpu_wddm_radv.dll. A process that uses D3D11 and D3D12 therefore loads one RADV build

system Vulkan ICD (mesa fork 2732f9c8, published on branch amdgpu-wddm/gdi-immediate-quiet, the build the lab registers). b19 keeps it. The b19 ICD 822134D0 is newer. Its branch does not carry the work of this build: the IMMEDIATE present on the GDI path without the DwmFlush wait, and host-cached present memory. That work has to come onto the b19 ICD line before the system ICD can move. docs/testing/defaults-audit-2026-10-04.md row 6 names what this build costs: no shader disk cache, and no ICD change after 2026-09-27

H.264 encoder Media Foundation transform (bc250-win 689852a8, train/b20-setup, which carries e52/encoder-perf e4d1f630). The encoder holds two pictures at once, it filters a whole picture in one dispatch, and its rate control reads the quantiser the content needs. A client that asks for low latency still gets one picture at a time. BC250_MFT_DEPTH=1, BC250_MFT_DEBLOCK=waves and BC250_MFT_SERIAL_DEBLOCK each select an older part. The conformance sweep is 76 of 76, and 60 of 60 pictures stay bit exact against the inbox decoder. The build matches the hash the wagon recorded
